messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate on notifier-service -> external-sms (Twilio) and mailer-service -> sendgrid. Error rate ~22% for sms, ~9% for email over last 5m. Triggered 2025-10-20T09:40:34Z. Oncall @Priya V.

Priya V: Ack. I'm seeing `upstream 502/503` from api.twilio.com and `timeouts` from smtp.sendgrid.net. Starting triage now.

Tom H: Adding context: our notifier-service uses a short circuit to fallback to backup-provider when failures cross threshold. That circuit hasn't tripped yet because we have per-provider per-region counters. Looks like only us-east is affected.

Elena (support): Support queue is light but we have a few tickets for failed 2FA codes and welcome emails not arriving. Marking P1 for verification failures.

Priya V: Reproduced sample errors in logs: `ERROR notifier: send failed: 502 Bad Gateway from api.twilio.com` and `Mailer: connection timeout after 10s to smtp.sendgrid.net`.

Alex P: Can we enable provider fallback now? Config key `provider_priorities.sms` supports `rotate` mode. If safe, flip for verification flows only.

Priya V: I'll enable fallback with a canary: 15% of verification traffic -> backup-sms (nexmo-proxy). Command:
```
POST /api/flags/sms_fallback {"enabled":true,"canary":15}
```

Observability Bot: Metric update: notification-queue depth increased to 340 (baseline 40). Top queue: verification-queue. Avg processing latency 180s.

Tom H: While fallback ramps, I'm throttling non-essential transactional emails (newsletters/digests) at the mailer gateway to reduce load: `sendrate(limit)=100/s` and pausing hourly digest cron.

Elena (support): Quick workaround for customers: support can use admin panel to generate a one-time in-app code (visible to agent). Creating KB: "When SMS/email delayed: generate in-app code" and link to template.

Priya V: Fallback canary is live. Monitoring delivery metrics. Also increasing retry windows for outbound attempts from 3 -> 6 retries with backoff.

Observability Bot: Canary results: backup-sms delivered rate healthy; overall sms failure rate drops from 22% -> 7% after 12 minutes. Verification queue latency improved to 60s.

Alex P: Good. Next steps: public status update draft: "We're experiencing degraded delivery of SMS and email due to upstream provider issues impacting verification and transactional notifications in US-EAST. We've enabled fallback for verification and paused non-critical mailings. We're monitoring and will update." Approve?

Maya S (cs): Please include note for CSMs: "If customers complain about auth issues, advise generating in-app codes or resending once provider stable." I'm DMing top 10 at-risk accounts.

Priya V: Opening provider tickets: Twilio CASE-100221 and SendGrid CASE-100222. Twilio acknowledges degradation in us-east and says their network team is investigating. SendGrid notes elevated edge errors and is investigating.

Tom H: Capturing mitigations to post-incident: 1) Auto-fallback threshold tuning; 2) Faster circuit open on per-region errors; 3) Add multi-provider runbook and testplaybook; 4) Increase alerting granularity per region/provider.

Elena (support): Logging KB created and pushed to #support-resources. Template added to incident.

Priya V: Handoff: I need to step out in 25m. Passing to Tom H for continued monitoring. I'll update incident timeline and bug tracker.

Tom H: Taking over. Will keep this thread live and escalate if provider status changes. Planning a postmortem with stakeholders tomorrow 10:00PT.

incident-bot: Incident INC-7501 status: mitigated (fallback enabled, non-critical mailings paused). Will close page in 1.5h if stable. Please add notes to incident doc.

Maya S (cs): Thanks team. Sending customer note now and prepping follow-ups. :pray:
